jobs.description:
We guarantee that you won’t be bored
 

As a process operator, you have several responsibilities: 
 
 

• You will receive an intensive training before coordinating and operating high-end devices in the clean room. 

• You organize your own workload according to defined goals. 

• You are responsible for the quality of your own processing. 

• You perform quality tests meticulously. 

• You accurately report problems to our engineers.  

• You have a keen eye for safety and operational efficiency. 

• You suggest improvements.  

Who are we looking for?
 

Well, an enthusiastic personality and a passion for technology already go a long way. You are hands-on, full of expectation and eager to prove yourself. You enjoy working in a team, are accurate, dare to take initiative and are not afraid of asking questions. You have fluent communication skills in English. You are not looking for a typical nine-to-five and you see the advantages of working in shifts every now and again — handsome bonusses and lots of quality time on your hands while others are ‘insanely busy’. An example of our shift regime:
 
 

• Week X: You will work the early shift from Monday to Friday. 

• Week X+1: You work the night shift from Monday to Friday. 

• Week X+2: You work the late shift from Monday to Wednesday, on Thursday and Friday you have recuperation and on Saturday and Sunday you work 12h. 

• Week X+3: From Monday to Wednesday you have recuperation and on Thursday and Friday you work in the late shift. 

• Week X: You work from Monday to Friday in the early shift.

Are you an experienced Wintel System Engineer with a passion for Microsoft infrastructure and hybrid cloud environments? Do you enjoy taking technical ownership, solving complex infrastructure challenges and helping customers modernize their IT environments?

At Inetum, we're looking for a hands-on Wintel System Engineer to strengthen our infrastructure expertise and support our customers in transforming and optimizing their Microsoft environments.

In this role, you'll work on challenging infrastructure projects, with a strong focus on Windows Server technologies, Active Directory, SQL Server platforms and hybrid cloud environments.

You'll be involved in the entire project lifecycle, from technical analysis and planning to implementation, migration, validation and documentation.

Your key responsibilities:

• Design, implement, maintain and optimize Microsoft-based infrastructure environments.
• Lead and execute end-to-end server migrations, including Windows Server upgrades and infrastructure modernization projects.
• Manage and migrate Active Directory environments, including domain migrations, DNS, DHCP, Group Policies and authentication services.
• Implement and support Microsoft SQL Server environments, including platform upgrades, Always On Availability Groups and Windows Failover Clustering.
• Perform application and file server migrations, ensuring business continuity and minimal downtime.
• Work with hybrid infrastructure environments, combining on-premises Microsoft technologies with cloud-based solutions.
• Prepare and execute migration strategies, including cutover planning, rollback scenarios and post-migration validation.
• Troubleshoot complex infrastructure issues and provide sustainable technical solutions.
• Collaborate directly with customers, understand their technical requirements and take ownership of project delivery.
• Deliver clear technical documentation, as-built documentation and knowledge transfer to operational teams.
You'll operate with a high degree of autonomy, taking responsibility for your projects while collaborating with specialized experts whenever specific technical challenges require additional expertise.

Do you have a strong technical background in Microsoft infrastructure and several years of hands-on experience?

Your technical expertise includes:

• Windows Server: Extensive experience with Windows Server 2016, 2019, 2022 and preferably 2025.
• Active Directory: Strong knowledge of AD DS, DNS, DHCP, Group Policy Objects (GPO) and FSMO roles.
• Security & Authentication: Understanding of Kerberos, service accounts, authentication mechanisms and Microsoft PKI / Certificate Services.
• SQL Server: Experience with SQL Server 2019/2022, Always On Availability Groups and SQL platform migrations.
• High Availability: Knowledge of Windows Failover Clustering and business-critical infrastructure environments.
• Microsoft Infrastructure Services: Experience with IIS, File Services, DFS, NTFS permissions, Remote Desktop Services (RDS) and RemoteApp.
• Virtualization: Operational knowledge of VMware vSphere.
• Hybrid Cloud: Good understanding of hybrid Microsoft infrastructure environments and their integration with cloud technologies.
• Migration Projects: Proven experience with end-to-end server, domain, application and file server migrations.
• Project Delivery: Experience with migration planning, cutover execution, rollback strategies, technical validation and documentation.
And are you…

• An experienced Wintel Engineer with approximately 5–10+ years of relevant experience?
• A hands-on technical expert who enjoys taking ownership from start to finish?
• Comfortable independently managing complex infrastructure migrations?
• Strong in troubleshooting, root cause analysis and problem-solving?
• Someone who combines technical expertise with a pragmatic, solution-oriented mindset?
• A clear communicator who enjoys working directly with customers and technical stakeholders?
• Structured in your approach, with attention to documentation, knowledge sharing and quality?
• A team player who knows when to involve specialized expertise?
• Fluent in Dutch and English, with French as an additional asset?
Then you might be the Wintel System Engineer we're looking for!

jobs.occupation: Oliver James Associates - Senior Azure / .NET Architect
jobs.description:
We're reimagining a mission-critical communication platform that powers how systems exchange data, files, and events with the outside world. This is not a greenfield toy project-it's a high-impact transformation at scale.

As a Senior Azure .NET Architect, you'll help design and shape a next-generation, cloud-native integration platform. You'll take an existing, complex ecosystem and turn it into a resilient, high-performance, event-driven architecture running on Azure.

If you enjoy solving hard distributed systems problems and building platforms that truly matter-this role is for you.
💡 What you'll be doing

You won't just "contribute"-you'll shape the future architecture:

• Design and build a modern communication layer handling message and file ingestion, transformation, routing, and delivery (sync + async)

• Create resilient, fault-tolerant systems using proven patterns like retries, circuit breakers, idempotency, and event-driven workflows

• Architect scalable event-driven solutions using Azure messaging services and/or Kafka-style pub/sub systems

• Build high-quality .NET services (.NET 7/8, C#, ASP.NET Core, gRPC/REST) with a strong engineering culture (TDD, clean code, performance-first)

• Deploy and operate workloads on Kubernetes (AKS/OpenShift) using Helm and modern CI/CD pipelines

• Define observability from day one: logging, tracing, metrics, SLOs, and actionable runbooks

• Collaborate in a truly agile setup, working closely with engineers, product owners, and other teams

• Mentor and elevate others-your experience will help raise the bar across the team

🎯 Why this role stands out

• High impact: You're building a core platform that everything depends on

• Real engineering challenges: Distributed systems, scalability, resilience-no trivial work here

• Modern tech stack: Cloud-native, Kubernetes, event-driven, .NET latest

• Ownership & influence: Your architectural decisions will shape the platform long-term

• Collaborative culture: Work with experienced engineers who care about doing things right

• Extensive experience in software engineering (15+ years), including building distributed, high-throughput, or mission-critical systems

• Strong hands-on Azure expertise (AKS, Functions, messaging services, Storage, monitoring, CI/CD)

• Deep knowledge of .NET (C#, modern .NET, async programming, testing practices)

• Solid understanding of event-driven architecture and distributed system trade-offs

• Experience with Docker and Kubernetes in production environments

• A mindset focused on quality, automation, and continuous improvement

• Confidence to make architectural decisions and guide others

• Strong communication skills in English

 

🌟 bonus points:

• Experience with observability stacks (Opentelemetry, tracing, logging platforms)

• Exposure to large-scale messaging or file transfer systems

• Knowledge of secure integration protocols (e.g., sFTP, AS2/AS4, messaging queues)

• Experience working in regulated or high-reliability environments

jobs.occupation: Oliver James Associates - Data Functional Analyst
jobs.description:
Oliver James is partnering with a leading enterprise organization migrating its core legacy systems from Adabas (Mainframe) to PostgreSQL.

We are seeking a Data Functional Analyst to bridge the gap between legacy business logic and modern database architecture. Working directly alongside Data Engineers and DBAs, you will define data mappings and ensure a seamless, high-integrity migration.
Key responsibilities

• 
Legacy Data Analysis & Mapping: Deep-dive into Mainframe data structures and define accurate functional target mappings to PostgreSQL relational schemaq

• 
Technical & Functional Guidance: Act as the primary functional advisor for Data Engineers and DBAs, writing clear functional specifications to guide ETL/ELT pipeline development and schema design

• 
Data Quality & Reconciliation: Design data validation strategies, define test scenarios, and execute cross-database reconciliation checks (Mainframe legacy vs. PostgreSQL) to guarantee 100% data integrity and consistency

• 
Data Lineage & Documentation: Maintain comprehensive data dictionaries, mapping rulebooks, and lineage documentation throughout the migration lifecycle

• 
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Serve as the functional point of contact for resolving legacy data ambiguities and translating complex business rules for the technical delivery team

• 
Functional Data Expertise: 3 years of experience as a Data Functional Analyst, Business Data Analyst, or Data Consultant on large-scale data transformation projects

• 
Database & SQL Skills: Strong, mandatory expertise in PostgreSQL and advanced proficiency in SQL and relational data modelling concepts

• 
Mainframe Experience: Solid functional understanding of Mainframe database environments (knowledge of Adabas is nice to have, but not mandatory)

• 
Migration Track Record: Hands-on experience working on complex legacy-to-relational data migration projects

• 
Language skills

• 
Fluent English (written and spoken)

• 
Professional fluency in French and/or Dutch (essential for local team and business stakeholder collaboration)

• 
Communication & Mindset: Excellent analytical skills, rigorous attention to detail, and the ability to articulate complex functional rules clearly to technical teams

Senior PowerBuilder Developer

Technical leadership and application modernisation

Brussels * Hybrid * 3 days on site per week

Contract options: permanent, fixed-term or freelance | Start: as soon as possible

About the role

Help shape the next chapter of a business-critical application. You will combine hands-on PowerBuilder development and production support with technical leadership, preparing an established client/server platform for a progressive transition to Java and Angular.

The role connects existing application knowledge with future development: understanding how the system works, making its business rules explicit and helping developers carry them into the new platform.

Your responsibilities

• Resolve complex PowerBuilder issues and share production maintenance duties, following agreed support and documentation practices.
• Analyse application components and dependencies, including PBLs, PowerScript, PFC, DataWindows and DataStores.
• Identify business rules, edge cases and redundant behaviour; separate functional requirements from interface logic and historical workarounds.
• Decouple business logic from GUI controls and database access, including embedded SQL, dynamic SQL and stored procedures.
• Work with analysts and business specialists to translate existing behaviour into clear functional and technical specifications.
• Collaborate with Java/Angular developers on REST API contracts and validate regression coverage through characterisation and Golden Master tests.
• Build shared technical documentation, mentor colleagues and use static analysis and AI-assisted tools to maintain traceability between code and specifications.

What you bring

• At least 5 years of hands-on PowerBuilder development, with strong expertise in the PowerBuilder 8-2022 / Appeon environment.
• Advanced PowerScript and PFC knowledge: events, functions, structures, transaction handling (SQLCA, COMMIT, ROLLBACK), complex DataWindows (Composite, Group, Nested), expressions (Describe, Modify, Evaluate) and DataStores.
• Strong relational database and SQL skills, including transactional SQL, PL/SQL stored procedures and query optimisation.
• Understanding of stateless REST APIs, microservices, Spring Boot, Angular and JSON DTOs. Practical Java/Spring Boot and/or Angular experience, or a strong aptitude and willingness to develop these skills.
• An analytical approach, clear documentation for non-PowerBuilder developers and confident communication with business stakeholders, management and technical teams.
• French or Dutch, together with professional fluency in English.
Why consider this role

A hands-on technical lead opportunity combining production continuity, knowledge sharing and modernisation. Contribute to team development while building on your PowerBuilder expertise and expanding your involvement in Java and Angular.
